native_meanings.source: C130 isolates the waiting intention and asks the engineer/operator/task owner to examine actual responsiveness and explicit failure/resumption. Its criterion and examination rule permit a scoped assessment of an actual episode.
native_meanings.target: EAA030 retains the origin and evidential status of consequential experience, separates observations and corrections from generated interpretations, and permits later observations or external checks to challenge the record.

decisions.producer: A criterion-matched examination of actual wait, reactive-arrival, handling and terminal events; an isolation label or an arbitrary stored log is insufficient.
decisions.produced_operand: An interpreted episode assessment with evidence identity and bounded support, contradiction or unknown status.
decisions.actual_consumer: The EAA030 curation operation consumes the matched assessment to qualify the retained generated claim; the later trial selector then consumes the serialized/reloaded qualified record.
decisions.changed_consequence: The claim that unrelated events were handled during generation changes from INTERPRETATION_UNVERIFIED to CONTRADICTED_BY_THIS_BOUNDED_CHECK. The later consumer changes from needing a relevant check to revising the wait configuration before the next bounded trial. External action authority remains false.
decisions.joint_guard: An actual C130 examination interprets observed wait/reactive and failure/resumption behavior against an independently stated, scoped criterion. The assessment and receiving record concern the same task, actor, runtime/version, episode, observation horizon and relevant obligation. Origin, interpretation, proposition-specific observation sufficiency, legitimate retention purpose and an actual future consumer are independently established. A complete observation interval is needed only where the asserted negative depends on absence throughout that interval; a witnessed positive event can support its narrower existential claim without certifying all obligations. Serialization preserves assessment, origin and limits and supplies no additional warrant. Action permission remains separate.
decisions.premise_discharged: The bounded evidential qualification of this retained claim, through an actually consumed external check.
decisions.premises_still_open: Legitimate access/retention, future purpose, reliable observation and interpretation, current applicability, completeness of any stronger claim, and all action permissions. The assessment does not originate the memory policy.
decisions.positive_case: The isolated-wait case handles alarm and status while planning waits, and the retained record becomes consistent with that bounded check. This supports an observed opportunity, not all future deadlines.
decisions.failure_witness: The blocked loop receives alarm at tick 2 and status at tick 4; neither is handled before resumption at tick 7. The matched adverse assessment contradicts the saved success claim and is actually consumed by the later selector.
decisions.boundary_and_nontrigger: Wrong task, actor, runtime/version or episode supplies no qualification of this record. Missing interpretation or insufficient negative observation coverage leaves the relevant claim unknown. No legitimate future memory consumer can make retention unjustified even when the examination is useful.
decisions.countercontrol_and_alternative: A scheduler using transient continuation state can preserve responsiveness without experience memory. An adequate current direct check can qualify the claim without this persistent carrier. A useful assessment need never be retained.
decisions.historical_error: The old reverse negative tested whether memory is needed as an input to scheduling. Its source assessment additionally demanded that C130 create a full memory criterion or obligation. Neither defeats a partial examination-result input to existing memory curation.
decisions.reentry_condition: Reassess if the actual assessment/record/consumer binding, interpretation, observation horizon, retention purpose or adequate alternative changes; do not infer a return from a forward relation alone.
decisions.evidence_ceiling: This is a finite analytical examination-result interface. It does not prove every responsiveness obligation, deadlines, fairness, capacity, safe late-plan enactment, future applicability, whole memory validity or action authority. No JaKtA or LLM experiment, empirical replication, measured benefit, new property, or independent acceptance is claimed.

historical_argument.contribution: EAA030 actually retains consequential observed experience with origin, evidential status and correction limits, separates it from generated interpretation, and delivers it to the named later native consumer. The reviewer runs isolated-wait, whole-loop-blocked, timeout, missing-reactive-capacity and no-concurrent-obligation episodes. Actual arrival/handling events discriminate preserved responsiveness from a blocking wait; an isolation label without capacity fails, and the synchronous no-obligation case is a nontrigger. The retained/selected carrier is actually consumed by the engineering evaluator, although the scheduler itself can run from transient state. The new author five-current-episode suite keeps the rare five-tick delay through selection and returns unknown if it is forgotten; that single contrary witness also suffices to refute the suite claim. A confirmed context update retires an old version only from current eligibility while preserving valid retrospective evaluation. This establishes a bounded forward evaluation operand and a separate EAA031 operation. Neither event generation nor scheduler observation produces native memory legitimacy or retirement authority in reverse.

Runtime observation is relevant, but no memory endpoint is a member. Its existing monitoring concern is preserved without a new internal return.
Generated-plan enforcement remains distinct. C130 membership alone does not establish a curation or selection member.
Resource and responsiveness limits survive. The return supplies evidence elsewhere, not an extra resource or memory mechanism inside this profile.
Only EAA030 and C130 coexist. The internal explanation adds curation feedback and does not add EAA031.
Deployment monitoring may produce relevant assessments; current cluster membership has no memory endpoint and is unchanged.
Bounded reasoning/responsiveness retains its direct-current-state alternative; no memory member is inserted.
All three are conditional members; both separately guarded branches are explained. No required mechanism or whole-system assurance is added.
C130 is present but the two memory properties are absent. Preserve the adequate current-state hybrid and describe any outside memory use as a separate interface.
The Q14 bundle has C130 but no memory endpoint; its participating properties and internal relation list remain exact.
The correction qualifies a conditional memory use without changing this question support set or answering all operational-closure requirements.
No new memory premise is silently inserted into the claim. The bounded return is not whole-family effectiveness evidence.

novelty.reason: The new evidence route adds no criterion to N014. Its C130 parent still protects scoped responsive waiting; curation/selection instantiate existing EAA030/EAA031 criteria but those two properties are not inserted into N014 parent membership. An actual contradiction can qualify a record while plan validity, authority, external effects and whole generative closure remain unresolved.
novelty.removal: Removing this C130 assessment removes this source of warrant; an adequate direct check can substitute. Removing memory removes the later retained-record route while the scheduling criterion survives. Removing the MAS lineage from this new EAA/EAOSE interface leaves the two demonstrated functions, so it establishes no three-lineage necessity. No full-parent-satisfaction witness of a residual criterion is produced.
novelty.history_limit: The original twelve per-parent and three per-lineage entries are bounded reasoning, not complete reduced implementations. Their exact content, parent identities, subsumers and adverse examples remain.
